newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 19.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Dec. 19 edition:
WASHINGTON - On the fifth day of a strike by Giant Food Inc. truckers, small groups of Teamsters picketed a dozen Giant supermarkets in the area.
WASHINGTON - The recommendation of a congressional commission for a downward revision of the consumer price index is encountering strong criticism from some economists.

WASHINGTON - Texaco Inc., which last month reached the largest settlement in history in a race discrimination suit, announced a plan to diversify its workforce and expand its ventures with businesses owned by minorities and women.
WASHINGTON - For Washington area residents who heat their homes with natural gas, the outlook could be chilling.
WASHINGTON - Kenneth Herman, founder of Shoppers Food Warehouse Corp. said he will accept an offer to sell his half of the supermarket chain for $210 million to Dart Group Corp.
